name: Who's Lying?
desc:
Welcome to Who's Lying? 🚨 UPDATES EVERY WEEKEND

🎁 NEW code "UPDATE" - Use for free in-game rewards!

How to Play:
📝 Investigators will be given a random secret word!
💬 Describe the word without being specific and never tell the exact word. Anyone can be an Liar!
🕵️‍♂️ Find out who is a Liar (Impostor) and kick out of the game to win!


⚠️ WARNING - The game needs at least 3 players to start!
🏆 PREMIUM BENEFITS - Exclusive reaction!

🔔 Inspired by: Full Squad Gaming's Guess The Impostor Series 
Similar to other games like: Among Us & Spyfall
